details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: chunk data smuggling in the APNG push-mode reader
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-40930.patch: consume the chunk body and the
       CRC field in the three inter-frame discard paths of
       png_push_read_chunk (pngpread.c), so that bytes inside an ignored
       chunk are no longer reinterpreted as a fresh chunk header on the
       next png_process_data call, and pass the real chunk length to
       png_ensure_sequence_number in png_push_read_IDAT (pngpread.c), so
       that an fdAT chunk shorter than its own sequence number no longer
       underflows idat_size and swallows the rest of the stream as frame
       data
     - CVE-2026-40930
